subject: Idea for Gatorland
body:
Hi,

I came across Gatorland and spent some time looking through the experiences on offer. What stood out most was the Screamin' Gator Zip Line — 1,200 feet above live alligators and crocodiles is a visual and adrenaline combination that very few attractions in Florida can offer, and the aerial perspective over the park is unlike anything else in Orlando content.

From what I saw, Gatorland already looks strong, but I think the content could build from the ground-level wildlife encounters into the aerial zip line moment — so the viewer feels the scale and contrast, not just highlights.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had would build from preparation through the zip line arc, keeping it premium while still capturing the raw energy of the experience.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Gatorland.

Best,
Malachi
